'''2018 MPC Wayne Cullen LS Yavin 4 Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Wayne Cullen]] at [[2018 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Wayne Cullen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4 Operations / The Time To Fight Is Now]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-match-play-championships/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013163128/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2018-match-play-championships.html Internet Archive]
